Q: Error "ImportError: No module named elftools.common.py3compat" A:

Actually, I resolved the issue. I installed paramiko using sudo. However, I had to pass the -H switch to sudo, such that the installation was valid for the normal user:

sudo -H pip install paramiko

Q: Meaning of parentheses () in Next.js path A:

Folder parentheses (auth) is Route Group & it's not part of URL

Example: Big application can be arranged in root directories (e.g., (auth), (admin), (dashboard))

app/
├── (auth)/
│   ├── create-passwor.tsx
│   ├── login.tsx
│   ├── signup.tsx
│   ├── verification.tsx
│   
├── (admin)/
│   ├── user.tsx
│   ├── settings.tsx
│   
├── (dashboard)/
│   ├── profile.tsx
│      
└── page.tsx

Your project 4 url:

  • /(auth)/create-password → /create-password
  • /(auth)/login → /login
  • /(auth)/signup → /signup
  • /(auth)/verification → /verification

Works fine:

<Link href="/create-password">Create password</Link>

404 error:

<Link href="/(auth)/create-password">Create password</Link>

Q: How to escape square brackets inside square brackets for field name A:

Hang a ] on the end of inline []

SELECT [Eggs[scrambled]] or Bacon[fried]]] FROM Yummy

Q: Should (double)(std::float16_t(1024) + std::float16_t(1025)) be 2048.0 or 2049.0? A:

By default, if a target does not support short floating operations natively, std::float16_t maps to the compiler supported __fp16 that is used as a storage format. It is promoted to float as soon as you do calculations on it. Arithmetic operations on __fp16 give float results.

A compiler also may support _Float16 that is as a storage, interchange and arithmetic format. Arithmetic operations on _Float16 give _Float16 results.

Use the compiler flag -fallow-half-arguments-and-returns to map std::float16_t to _Float16 if a target supports _Float16 natively (ARM for example). Note, this breaks the standard ABI.
Just read that -fallow-half-arguments-and-returns is removed, and the mapping std::float16_t to __fp16 or _Float16 depends on compiler target info.

For example, use -march=armv8.2-a+fp16 or -march=armv9-a on ARM and they give the expected result 2048

Q: Prevent AI tooling from making changes to the DB A:

We have a separate database team than the development team I work on. We can task them to create a readonly user for the AI, but we'd rather not go through that trouble, if possible.

Why not? This problem has nothing to do with AI - you just have some process which you think should be able to read from the database but should not be able to write to it. And that's exactly what database privileges are there for.

For any non-trivial system, this should be a routine thing to do. E.g. if you have some process which does reporting, it should have its own service account (for auditing), and since a report typically doesn't need write access, it shouldn't be given write access.

Q: Given a multi-commit PR, how to go from a file in "Files changed" to the commit(s) where that file was changed? A: 
1 parent f09500b  commit b87bdb9

So... the commit you are dealing with is, from git's POV, a straight non-merge commit... what is also known as a "squash" merge. When this happens, there is no way for git to be able to know the original line of commits where those changes had come from (the information about the original commits might be in the comment of the commit but git won't consider it for analysis, only the parents of the commits are considered).... If it had been a merge proper, then git without additional help would have no problem going through the branch where those changes had been created from... that is why in your case you would have to help git by providing it with the original branch commit (the tip that was merged) so that it would be able to blame from there:

git blame bd1404fd2 -- <some-file>

Q: can't find org.springframework.kafka.core.reactive.ReactiveKafkaConsumerTemplate A:

It seems this class is no longer supported, and removed as of the 4.0.0 release of spring-kafka.

See: Reactor Kafka Project Will Be Discontinued

The Reactive template in Spring for Apache Kafka will be deprecated and marked for future removal.
